title: Internal and External Communications & PR Specialist
description:
Internal and External Communications & PR Specialist

Salary: £35,570 per annum
Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (6 Months)
Hours: 37 hours per week
Location: Hybrid Working (Maximum of 2 days per week in the office)

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and proactive Internal and External Communications & PR Specialist to join our Communications Team on a six-month fixed-term contract. This is an exciting opportunity to support the council's communications objectives by delivering engaging internal communications, managing external public relations activity, and helping to strengthen the authority's reputation among residents, partners, stakeholders and employees.
The successful candidate will play a key role in planning and delivering communications campaigns, producing high-quality content, managing media enquiries, and ensuring staff and stakeholders are informed, engaged and connected to the council's priorities and services.

Key ResponsibilitiesInternal Communications
- Develop and deliver internal communications plans that inform, engage and inspire employees.
- Create compelling content for staff newsletters, intranet platforms, leadership messages and internal campaigns.
- Support organisational change programmes through clear and effective communication.
- Promote employee engagement initiatives and celebrate organisational achievements.
- Work with services across the council to ensure consistent messaging and timely communication.

External Communications and PR
- Develop and implement communications and PR campaigns aligned to council priorities.
- Draft press releases, statements, briefing notes, speeches and other external communications materials.
- Manage media enquiries and cultivate positive relationships with local, regional and sector media outlets.
- Monitor media coverage and provide advice on reputational issues and emerging risks.
- Support the promotion of council services, projects and events through a range of communication channels.
- Assist with crisis and reactive communications when required.

Digital Content and Stakeholder Engagement
- Produce engaging content for digital channels, including websites, social media and email communications.
- Ensure all communications are accurate, accessible and compliant with relevant legislation and council standards.
- Build positive working relationships with elected members, senior leaders, community organisations and key partners.
- Monitor communications performance and provide reports on campaign outcomes and media activity.

Person SpecificationEssential Knowledge and Experience
- Experience in a communications, public relations or media relations role.
- Demonstrable experience producing content for both internal and external audiences.
- Experience managing media enquiries and developing positive media relationships.
- Strong copywriting, editing and proof-reading skills.
- Experience delivering communications campaigns across multiple channels.
- Understanding of digital communications and social media management.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.

Essential Skills
- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational and project management abilities.
- Ability to translate complex information into clear and engaging content.
- Sound judgement and the ability to handle sensitive or confidential information appropriately.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Desirable
- Experience working within local government, the public sector or a similarly regulated environment.
- Knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive communications.
- Experience supporting change communications or employee engagement initiatives.

Working Arrangements

This role offers flexible hybrid working, with a maximum requirement of two days per week in the office and the remainder worked remotely, subject to business needs.

What We Offer
- Salary of £35,570 per annum.
- Flexible hybrid working arrangements.
- Opportunity to contribute to meaningful public sector work that positively impacts local communities.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Valuable experience within a dynamic local authority communications team.

How to Apply

If you are a skilled communications professional with experience in internal communications, external relations and public relations, we would welcome your application. Please submit your CV and a supporting statement demonstrating how you meet the requirements of the role.

title: Marketing and Sales Support
description:
Are you a creative and organised marketing professional who enjoys supporting sales and bringing campaigns to life?

We are working with a leading organisation within the commercial vehicle and transport sector, who are looking for a Marketing and Sales Support professional to support their marketing activity, customer engagement, events and sales function.

This is a varied role where you will be involved in marketing campaigns, social media, exhibitions, customer events, content, lead generation and sales administration, making it an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys variety and likes seeing their work have a direct commercial impact.

Key Responsibilities:
- Coordinate marketing activity across social media, direct marketing, industry publications and events.
- Support exhibitions, trade shows and customer events, managing arrangements and promotional materials.
- Assist with creating and coordinating marketing content and campaigns.
- Work with internal teams and external suppliers to deliver marketing activity.
- Provide administrative support to the sales team, including reports, presentations and customer communications.
- Maintain accurate sales and marketing records, databases and internal systems.
- Support lead generation and follow up activity from campaigns and events.
- Identify opportunities to improve marketing processes and customer engagement.

Who They're Looking For:
- Previous experience in marketing, sales support, commercial administration, or a similar role.
- B2 B marketing experience with a good understanding of business to business activity.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Experience supporting marketing campaigns, events, exhibitions, or promotional activity.
- Good understanding of social media and digital marketing.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Confident using Microsoft Office and business systems.
- Creative, commercially aware, proactive and detail focused.

Benefits:
- 25 days holiday + bank holidays, increasing with service
- Life Assurance
- Enhanced Pension
- Employee Referral Scheme
- Employee Assistance Programme and wellbeing support

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established organisation in a varied role that combines marketing, sales, events and commercial support, with plenty of scope to make the position your own. Sound like you? Apply today to find out more.

title: Marketing Events Executive
description:
Marketing & Events Executive

Stafford Permanent Monday-Friday, 7:30am-4:30pm
- £40,000 - £45,000 basic salary
- Car allowance
- Profit Share Bonus Scheme following probation
- Daily lunch provided
- BUPA wellbeing and mental health support
- Ongoing training and professional development

Are you a commercially focused marketing professional with a passion for events, exhibitions and customer engagement?

Do you enjoy taking an idea from the planning stage through to delivery and seeing the direct impact it has on customers and the wider business?

We are looking for a Marketing & Events Executive to join an established and growing organisation based in the Stafford area. This is a hands-on position combining event management, customer engagement, content and wider marketing activity.

You will work closely with the marketing and commercial teams to deliver events and campaigns that strengthen the company's profile, create new opportunities and provide valuable insight into customers and the wider market.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll take ownership of a varied programme of marketing and event activity, including:
- Researching and selecting relevant exhibitions, conferences and industry events.
- Coordinating events from initial planning through to delivery and post-event follow-up.
- Managing event budgets, suppliers, promotional materials, logistics and deadlines.
- Attending exhibitions and events across the UK, representing the business and engaging with customers and prospects.
- Working alongside the sales team to maximise leads and opportunities generated through events.
- Measuring event performance, analysing leads and reporting on commercial return.
- Organising customer visits and gathering feedback and market intelligence.
- Developing customer stories, testimonials and case studies for use across marketing channels.
- Supporting the creation of presentations, brochures, sales literature and other marketing materials.
- Keeping up to date with competitor activity, industry developments and customer trends.
- Supporting brand awareness campaigns, product launches and other marketing initiatives.
- Maintaining accurate customer and activity information within the company's CRM.
- Providing general marketing support to the wider business and contributing new ideas.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an enthusiastic and commercially minded marketer who is comfortable working with customers, managing projects and representing a business at industry events.

You should have:
- At least 3 years' experience in events, event marketing, B2 B marketing or a similar role.
- Previous experience organising exhibitions, trade shows or customer-facing events.
- Strong project management and organisational skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- The confidence to build relationships with customers, prospects, suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- A proactive approach and the ability to manage several projects at the same time.
- A commercial mindset and an understanding of how marketing activity can contribute to business growth.
- A full UK driving licence and flexibility to travel nationally.
- Previous experience within engineering, manufacturing, industrial, construction, environmental or another technical B2 B environment would be advantageous.
- Experience using HubSpot or another CRM/marketing automation system would be beneficial.

title: Marketing Executive (Events & Customer Engagement)
description:
Package: £40,000 - £45,000 + Car Allowance + Profit Share Bonus + Development Opportunities

Location: Stafford area (Office-based, with National travel to Events & Customer Sites)

Are you an organised and commercially minded marketer who thrives on bringing events to life and building meaningful customer relationships?

Our client is seeking a Marketing Executive to take ownership of exhibitions, events and customer engagement activities that directly support business growth. This is a varied, customer-facing role where you will play a key part in strengthening brand presence, generating market insight and helping the commercial team convert opportunities into results.

This opportunity would suit someone who enjoys being at the centre of activity, coordinating multiple projects, engaging with customers and delivering events that create measurable commercial impact.

The Role

Working closely with the Marketing Manager and wider commercial team, you'll be responsible for planning, promoting and delivering exhibitions, trade shows and field marketing initiatives, whilst ensuring every activity delivers tangible value to the business.

Key responsibilities include:
- Planning and delivering exhibitions, events and field marketing campaigns
- Managing event logistics, suppliers, budgets and promotional activity
- Capturing and analysing event performance and ROI
- Conducting customer visits and gathering valuable market insight
- Developing customer testimonials, case studies and advocacy content
- Supporting the sales team with presentations, literature and marketing collateral
- Monitoring competitor activity, market trends and customer feedback
- Coordinating brand activation initiatives across multiple channels
- Supporting wider marketing projects and campaigns as required

About You

We're looking for a confident and personable marketing professional who enjoys building relationships and engaging with customers face-to-face.

You will ideally have:
- At least 3 years' experience within events marketing, or a similar B2 B marketing role
- Proven experience planning and executing exhibitions and events
- Excellent organisation and project management skills
- Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities
- A proactive, commercially aware mindset
- The confidence to engage with customers, prospects and internal teams
- A full UK driving licence
- Experience within industrial, engineering, manufacturing, environmental or construction sectors would be advantageous
- HubSpot experience would be beneficial but is not essential

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to join a growing, ambitious business with a genuine people-first culture. You'll be given autonomy, responsibility and the chance to make a visible impact, whilst benefiting from excellent support, ongoing development and clear opportunities to grow your marketing career.

If you're looking for a role that combines events, customer engagement, commercial marketing and relationship building, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager B2 B HubSpot
- £45,000 - £50,000 per annum
- Tamworth , Staffordshire - Hybrid working
- Training and development
- Career progression
- The opportunity to shape and develop the marketing function
- A commercially focused and growing environment

Are you an experienced Marketing Manager with a strong B2 B background and hands-on experience using HubSpot?

Are you looking for an opportunity where you can take ownership of the marketing function and play a key role in the growth of an innovative business?

As Marketing Manager, you will take ownership of the UK marketing strategy, developing and delivering campaigns that build brand awareness, generate high-quality leads and directly support commercial growth. Working closely with senior leadership, sales and product teams, you will have the opportunity to shape the company's marketing approach across digital channels, CRM, content, events and product launches.

The Role

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining strategic marketing planning with campaign execution, while having the freedom to develop processes, improve lead generation and make a measurable commercial difference.
- Develop and execute the UK marketing strategy in line with wider commercial objectives.
- Own and optimise HubSpot CRM, including marketing automation, workflows, customer journeys and lead management.
- Develop and deliver targeted B2 B campaigns to generate high-quality sales leads.
- Create and manage email campaigns, landing pages, forms, CTAs and lead nurturing journeys through HubSpot.
- Manage customer data, segmentation and CRM processes to improve engagement and conversion.
- Work closely with the sales team to improve lead quality, nurture prospects and support pipeline development.
- Create and oversee engaging content across social media, websites, email and wider digital channels.
- Support the marketing strategy for new products, services and commercial initiatives.
- Plan and coordinate industry events, exhibitions and other lead-generation activity.
- Monitor campaign performance and use data and reporting to continually improve marketing activity.
- Work closely with senior stakeholders to strengthen the company's brand and market presence.

About You
- Proven experience as a Marketing Manager or in a similar senior marketing position.
- Strong B2 B marketing experience, ideally within engineering, energy, technology, industrial or another technical environment.
- Hands-on HubSpot experience is essential, with confidence managing CRM, automation, workflows, campaigns and reporting.
- Strong understanding of B2 B lead generation, nurturing and marketing-to-sales processes.
- Experience creating and managing multi-channel digital marketing campaigns.
- Commercially minded, with the ability to connect marketing activity to measurable business results.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create engaging B2 B content.
- Organised, proactive and comfortable working in a growing business where you can take ownership and make decisions.

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to join a growing business at an exciting stage of its development, where marketing has a direct role to play in commercial growth.

You'll have genuine ownership of the marketing function, the opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and the freedom to develop and improve the company's marketing strategy.

If you're an experienced B2 B Marketing Manager with strong HubSpot expertise and are looking for a role where you can make a visible commercial impact, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Trade & Brand Marketing Manager
company: The Animal People Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
Trade & Brand Marketing Manager Premium Pet Industry Staffordshire Up to £45,000 + Bonus Hybrid

Can you lead the marketing, champion it internally AND still roll your sleeves up and make things happen?

We're working exclusively with one of the UK's most respected premium pet brands to find a Trade & Brand Marketing Manager who can take ownership of an established brand and help shape the next stage of its growth.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to sit purely at strategy level.

It's for someone who can see the bigger picture, bring people together around it and then make sure it actually happens.

The opportunity This is a broad, commercially focused marketing role within an independently owned, growing pet business.

Around two-thirds of the business comes through trade, so you'll work closely with sales, retailers, wholesalers and buying groups, while also helping develop the wider consumer brand.

You'll take the lead across trade and brand marketing; campaigns; product launches; retail activation; PR; events; digital activity and external agencies.

But there's another important part to this role.

You'll be an advocate for marketing across the wider business.

You'll need the confidence to work with senior stakeholders, challenge appropriately, make the commercial case for marketing priorities and secure the support and resource needed to deliver them.

Resources aren't unlimited, so we're looking for someone who knows how to prioritise, delegate and get the best from the people around them.

What you'll be doing You'll lead and coordinate marketing activity across trade, brand, digital and events; build marketing plans around wider commercial objectives; work closely with sales and account teams to support retailers and customers; lead campaigns and product launches from idea through to execution; manage budgets and demonstrate ROI; oversee agencies and external partners; develop POS, trade press, editorial and PR activity; and help create clear priorities, ownership and accountability across the marketing function.

You'll also play an important role in developing the people around you, bringing different areas of marketing together and ensuring everyone understands what needs to happen, who owns it and when it needs to be delivered.

Who we're looking for You might already be a Trade Marketing Manager, Brand Marketing Manager, Marketing Manager, Senior Marketing Manager or Head of Marketing within a smaller business.

Your title matters less than the level you're operating at.

We're looking for someone who can demonstrate strong trade and/or brand marketing experience; leadership or people management; confidence influencing senior stakeholders; commercial decision-making; budget ownership; campaign and project leadership; excellent organisation and prioritisation; and the ability to move comfortably between strategy and hands-on delivery.

Experience within pet, pet food, animal health, veterinary, premium FMCG, food & drink, nutrition, retail or another consumer brand would be particularly relevant.

Direct pet industry experience would be fantastic, but it isn't essential. We're equally interested in people who can bring fresh thinking from another sector and genuinely want to build their career within pet.

About the business They're an established, independently owned premium pet brand with an excellent reputation.

Their products are trusted by retailers, breeders, industry professionals and thousands of pet owners across the UK.

They've built that reputation through education, integrity and helping pet owners make informed decisions, rather than sensational marketing or shouting louder than everyone else.

There's already a strong brand, brilliant content, passionate people and plenty of ideas.

What they now need is somebody who can bring all of that together and create momentum.

What you'll receive Salary up to £45,000 DOE plus performance-related bonus; hybrid working with three days per week in the Staffordshire office and two from home; generous annual leave with additional service-related holiday; Christmas shutdown; workplace pension; Employee Assistance Programme; staff discount; pet-friendly office; professional development and free parking.

Why this role stands out You'll have genuine ownership and visibility.

You'll work directly with senior leaders and have the opportunity to influence how marketing develops as the business grows.

This is a brilliant opportunity for somebody who has already started operating at leadership level but still loves being close enough to the work to see their ideas come to life.

If you're commercially minded, confident with people and want the opportunity to make your mark within a premium pet brand, we'd love to hear from you.
